high_level_description: The image is split into two distinct sections. On the left side, there is a fashion runway scene. A male model is walking down the runway, wearing a long, dark coat over a white shirt and tie, paired with black pants and white sneakers. He has curly hair and is carrying a beige shoulder bag. The audience on either side of the runway is seated, attentively watching the model. Some individuals in the audience are holding up their phones to take photos or videos.
